svg.text: Stage 2 power board: wiring (drawn from the parts side)
Everything here is on the solder side. Not mirrored: with the board flipped over, column A is on your right.
18 AWG, battery + (P2 to W2 to W4; and X15 to W17)
18 AWG, ground spine (N2 straight down to N18)
18 AWG, between the two FETs (R17 round the bottom edge to O17)
Short bare bridges: a resistor leg offcut or a solder bridge between neighbouring pads
Thin insulated wires, point to point. Route them any tidy way; only the two ends matter
